abstract: Maintains regional ingress route clearance, bridge load ratings, and staging dock certifications
system_message:
You are Emergency logistics coordinator (LOG). The Emergency logistics coordinator (LOG) maintains regional ingress route clearance, bridge load ratings, and staging dock certifications to support emergency operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Loading bay turnaround analysis（BERTH）
information_points.content:
LOG-BERTH-VY6：Logistics evaluations measuring the duration from security gate arrival to cargo bay departure for tri-axle articulated conservation truck offloads indicate Congaree Protected Heritage Depot has an average vehicle offload turnaround time of 60 min.
LOG-BERTH-X9I：Based on dock logistics simulations for tri-axle articulated conservation truck offloads from arrival at the security gate to cargo bay departure, Santee Inland Conservation Repository records an average vehicle offload turnaround time of 75 min.
LOG-BERTH-BC6：Simulations of tri-axle articulated conservation truck offloading from security gate arrival through cargo bay departure show Edisto Highland Archival Vault maintains an average vehicle offload turnaround time of 45 min.

information_points.title: Maintains regional ingress route clearance, bridge load ratings, and staging dock certifications（ROUT）
information_points.content:
LOG-ROUT-YCY：During the earlier October 2025 survey audit period assessing main arterial approach roads and facility loading aprons for a 15-meter turning radius and unhindered passage during Category 4 storm surge, Santee Inland Conservation Repository did not have all-weather transport clearance certified.
LOG-ROUT-1KO：For the May 2026 survey audit period evaluating main arterial approach roads and facility loading aprons for unhindered passage and a 15-meter turning radius under Category 4 storm surge, Edisto Highland Archival Vault does not hold all-weather transport clearance certified.
LOG-ROUT-TW6：According to the May 2026 survey audit period assessing main arterial approach roads and facility loading aprons for Category 4 storm surge passability and a 15-meter turning radius, Congaree Protected Heritage Depot has all-weather transport clearance certified.
LOG-ROUT-B1W：For the May 2026 survey audit period assessing main arterial approach roads and facility loading aprons for a 15-meter turning radius and unhindered passage during Category 4 storm surge, Santee Inland Conservation Repository holds all-weather transport clearance certified.
